market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a tug-of-war: strong jobs data supports rate-hike fears pressuring equities, while AI capex and energy strength provide support. S&P 500 likely range-bound 5,200-5,500. Oil volatility at $95-100 range. Rate-sensitive sectors (mortgages, autos) under pressure. Crypto may test $85K on ETF flows.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and energy transition (Siemens/Rolls-Royce SMR) support structural growth. However, de-dollarization, China decoupling, and persistent energy inflation cap upside. Auto industry consolidation creates 2-3 year restructuring overhang. Fed likely to hike 25-50bps by Q1 2027, creating a higher-for-longer regime.
